title: Violence Against Women Act Defunding - Domestic Violence Support Elimination
description_short: Violence Against Women Act Defunding - Domestic Violence Support Elimination
description_medium: Advocates warned that federal grant changes and new award conditions could disrupt domestic-violence and sexual-assault services, including hotlines, housing, legal aid and counseling. Ohio’s 2025 VAWA solicitation remained open while warning that later Justice Department guidance could alter or cancel awards. These developments raised concerns about grant continuity but do not establish nationwide elimination of VAWA funding.

title: Trump: Mogilevich's Inkombank collapses after years of money laundering
description_short: Trump: Mogilevich's Inkombank collapses after years of money laundering
description_medium: The Bank of Russia revoked Inkombank’s license on October 27, 1998, during Russia’s financial crisis. A BBC report attributed the bank’s failure to the falling ruble, heavy customer withdrawals, excessive risk and frozen government treasury bills. The report does not connect the closure to Donald Trump or establish the title’s money-laundering claim.
description_long: Inkombank’s license was revoked by the Bank of Russia on October 27, 1998, during the country’s financial crisis. The BBC reported that the falling ruble and heavy demands from customers to withdraw deposits had weakened the bank. The regulator also cited excessive risks and government treasury bills that had been frozen; those bills represented about 11 percent of Inkombank’s assets. The bank had roughly 10,000 corporate and private shareholders. The Central Bank placed it under administration while a liquidation committee considered its assets. This account explains the immediate circumstances reported around the closure. It does not establish the later allegation that Inkombank was connected to a major money-laundering scheme, identify a court finding on that claim, or link the bank’s collapse to Donald Trump. The Trumpfile timeline page did not return readable text in the supplied review, so the historical event can be described from the BBC account while the title’s personal and criminal framing remains unresolved.

preserved_fields.title: Trump: Mogilevich's Inkombank collapses after years of money laundering
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump: Mogilevich's Inkombank collapses after years of money laundering

notes: The BBC article was readable and attributes Inkombank’s 1998 closure to the financial crisis, ruble decline, withdrawals, excessive risk and frozen treasury bills. It contains no Trump connection or later laundering-case disposition. The linked Trumpfile page returned HTTP 202. Proposed correction removes unsupported personal and criminal claims.
proposed_correction: Inkombank’s License Was Revoked During Russia’s 1998 Financial Crisis

title: Trump: A.J. Benza: Trump likes to brag about sex with women in Russia
description_short: Trump: A.J. Benza: Trump likes to brag about sex with women in Russia
description_medium: During a 2001 Howard Stern show call, gossip columnist A.J. Benza said Trump had previously told him to visit Russia to have sex with women. The Trumpfile transcript records Benza’s recollection during an argument about a personal dispute; the site says it cannot pinpoint the segment’s exact date, and the anecdote is not independently verified.
description_long: A.J. Benza recounted the story during a 2001 appearance on Howard Stern’s radio show, where Donald Trump called in to confront the gossip columnist over a personal dispute. Benza said Trump had called him when he was a columnist and told him, “I was just in Russia. The girls have no morals. You gotta get out there.” Trump talked over Benza during the exchange and denied knowing what he meant by “Russian people.” The Trumpfile page says Benza was a recurring guest and that the exact date of the segment is difficult to establish. The account is an anecdote attributed to Benza in a contentious live conversation, not independent confirmation of the prior calls or of sexual conduct in Russia. The description concerns what Benza said on air and Trump’s response in the same exchange; it does not treat the underlying claim as verified fact.

preserved_fields.title: Trump: A.J. Benza: Trump likes to brag about sex with women in Russia
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump: A.J. Benza: Trump likes to brag about sex with women in Russia

notes: The linked Trumpfile page was read directly and includes Benza’s quoted recollection and the on-air exchange. title: Trump: J.D. Vance starts military blog under name ‘JD Hamel'
description_short: Trump: J.D. Vance starts military blog under name ‘JD Hamel'
description_medium: The linked Trumpfile timeline says J.D. Vance began a military blog under the name JD Hamel on July 11, 2005, around his Iraq deployment. It describes later posts on public policy and a separate blog about Yale Law School. The event is biographical and does not identify a connection to Donald Trump at the time.
description_long: The Trumpfile timeline says J.D. Vance began a military-focused blog under the name JD Hamel on July 11, 2005, while commemorating his Iraq deployment. The page explains that he had been born James Donald Bowman, adopted the surname Hamel after his mother remarried, and served in the Marines as Corporal James D. Hamel. It describes a later, separate blog about his time at Yale Law School. One post in the military blog criticized both Democrats who objected to the budget effects of tax cuts and Republicans who objected to foreign aid on budgetary grounds. The timeline also quotes a 2024 Bulwark writer contrasting the views in those earlier posts with Vance’s later political identity. That comparison is commentary on the blog, not proof that the 2005 posts concerned Trump or his administration. The event is Vance’s writing under an earlier name during his military service; the title’s Trump prefix does not identify a direct connection to Trump at that time.

preserved_fields.title: Trump: J.D. Vance starts military blog under name ‘JD Hamel'
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump: J.D. Vance starts military blog under name ‘JD Hamel'

notes: The linked Trumpfile page was read directly and describes the blog, Vance’s earlier name and later law-school blog. The entry is dated to a period before his association with Trump and the article’s Trump prefix is not supported by the 2005 event. Proposed correction removes that association.
proposed_correction: J.D. Vance Starts Military Blog Under the Name JD Hamel
